definition_zh: 嘿；喂（引起注意的感叹词）
definition_en: a shout to attract attention or show surprise
core_image: 操场对面扬起的手和喊声
scene: 放学铃刚响，操场瞬间沸腾起来。Hey, wait for me at the school gate after class!
sceneCN: 这里 hey 是引起注意的感叹词「嘿、喂」（第 1 个义项）；句意为：嘿，下课后在校门口等我！

derivatives.zh: 同义的更常见问候感叹词，义为「嗨」
标准问候语，义为「你好」
旧式引起注意的喊声，义为「哟嗬」

senses.title: A call to get attention
senses.definition: a shout used to catch someone's attention
senses.definitionCN: 用来吸引他人注意的喊声
senses.example: Hey, wait for me at the school gate after class!
senses.exampleCN: 嘿，下课后在校门口等我！
senses.why: The core image is a raised hand and a shout across the playground, so attention comes first.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是操场上扬起的手和喊声，最基本的义项就是引起注意。

senses.title: An informal greeting
senses.definition: a casual friendly hello
senses.example: Hey, long time no see, how have you been?
senses.exampleCN: 嘿，好久不见，最近怎么样？
senses.why: A shout softened by a smile becomes a greeting.
senses.whyCN: 喊声被微笑软化，便成了问候。

senses.title: A cry of surprise or protest
senses.definition: an exclamation of surprise or mild anger
senses.definitionCN: 表示惊讶或轻微不满的感叹
senses.example: Hey, that is my seat you are sitting on!
senses.exampleCN: 嘿，你坐的是我的座位！
senses.why: The shout sharpens into objection.
senses.whyCN: 喊声变得尖锐，成了抗议。

intro.en: Hey is one of the oldest human shouts, a natural cry that writing captured early.
intro.cn: hey 是最古老的人类喊声之一，是书写很早就记录下来的自然呼喊。

items.en: Germanic speakers used natural cries like hei to call out.
items.cn: 日耳曼语者用 hei 这类自然呼喊来呼叫他人。

items.en: Old English records hē as an attention call.
items.cn: 古英语记录了表引起注意的 hē。

items.en: Middle English spelled the cry hei or hai in songs.
items.cn: 中古英语在歌谣中拼作 hei 或 hai。

items.en: Modern English hey settled as the everyday shout.
items.cn: 现代英语 hey 定型为日常喊声。

items.en: American speech widened hey into a greeting.
items.cn: 美式口语把 hey 扩展成问候语。

note.en: All look-alike sounds carry the open e; the near words differ in politeness.
note.cn: 形近词都带开口 e 音；近义词的差异在礼貌程度。

entries.definition: the best period of something, not a shout

normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于发音与形近词对比。

normal.en: hey sounds exactly like the hay horses eat, but it is a shout.
normal.cn: hey 的发音与马的干草 hay 相同，但它是喊声。

normal.en: hey + day = heyday, the golden period.
normal.cn: hey 加 day 构成 heyday，鼎盛期。

normal.en: Hey has one syllable, easy to shout across a field.
normal.cn: hey 单音节，方便隔场呼喊。

normal.en: Hey there works as a light hello.
normal.cn: hey there 可作轻快的问好。

normal.en: Hey, come on pushes people to hurry.
normal.cn: hey, come on 催人快些。

abstract.en: A hand waving high over a crowd of heads.
abstract.cn: 人海之上高高挥动的手。

abstract.en: A head turning fast toward a shout.
abstract.cn: 喊声传来，头猛地转过去。

abstract.en: An echo bouncing between two school walls.
abstract.cn: 回声在教学楼两墙之间弹跳。

examples.en: Hey, wait for me at the school gate after class!
examples.cn: 嘿，下课后在校门口等我！

examples.en: Mom waved and said hey from the porch.
examples.cn: 妈妈在门廊挥手喊了一声嘿。

examples.en: He gave a loud hey from the far corner of the field.
examples.cn: 他从场地那头大声喊了一声嘿。

sensesIntro.cn: 义项从引起注意的呼喊走向友好问候，再到惊讶与抗议。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a raised hand and a shout across the playground.
core.cn: 核心意象：操场对面扬起的手和喊声。

intro.cn: hey 通常独立使用，下列条目展示其他引起注意的声音与问候语。

definition_en: to put your arms around someone and hold them close
scene: 车站出口人潮涌动，行李箱轮子响成一片。Lily ran out and gave her grandmother a big hug.
sceneCN: 这里 hug 是「拥抱」（第 1 个义项：张开双臂环抱对方）；句意为莉莉跑出车站，给了祖母一个大大的拥抱。

derivatives.zh: 由 hug 加 -er 构成，义为「拥抱者」
近义动词，义为「依偎」
近义正式动词，义为「拥抱」

senses.title: To hold someone in your arms
senses.definition: to put your arms around a person
senses.example: Lily ran out and gave her grandmother a big hug.
senses.exampleCN: 莉莉跑出车站，给了祖母一个大大的拥抱。
senses.why: The core image is two arms closing around shoulders, so holding comes first.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是双臂环拢肩膀，最基本的义项就是环抱。

senses.title: To hold something close
senses.definition: to hold a thing tightly against the body
senses.example: The child hugged the teddy bear all through the night.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子整夜紧抱着玩具熊。
senses.why: The embrace widens from people to loved things.
senses.whyCN: 拥抱的对象由人扩至心爱之物。

senses.title: To stay close along a line
senses.definition: to keep very close to something, as a road hugging a coast
senses.definitionCN: 紧靠着某物，如道路紧贴海岸
senses.example: The narrow road hugs the cliff above the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 窄路紧贴海崖延伸。
senses.why: Two things pressed together borrow the embrace image.
senses.whyCN: 紧贴的两物借用了相拥的意象。

senses.title: A hug as a noun
senses.definition: the act of putting your arms around someone
senses.example: A hug can fix a day that went wrong.
senses.exampleCN: 一个拥抱能挽回糟糕的一天。
senses.why: The act names the comfort it gives.
senses.whyCN: 行为本身成为它带来的安慰的名称。

intro.en: Hug is a short Nordic word for the embrace, built on a root of cherishing.
intro.cn: hug 是来自北欧的短词，词根与珍爱相关。

items.en: Old Norse hugga meant to comfort or soothe.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 hugga 意为安慰、抚慰。

items.en: The related root also carried the sense of embracing in spirit.
items.cn: 相关词根还含精神上拥抱之意。

items.en: Middle English hugge took the bodily embrace sense.
items.cn: 中古英语 hugge 承载了身体的拥抱义。

items.en: Low German dialects kept the same comfort root.
items.cn: 低地德语方言保留同一安慰词根。

items.en: Modern English hug added road-and-river hugging senses.
items.cn: 现代英语 hug 又添道路与河流紧贴之义。

note.en: All hug words describe arms closing; they differ in warmth and formality.
note.cn: hug 词族都写双臂合拢；差异在热度与正式度。

entries.definitionCN: 拥抱者，由 hug 加 -er 构成
名词复数或第三人称形式

entries.definition: to grip tightly with hands or arms

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the sound shape and the doubling spelling rule.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于发音形态与双写规则。

normal.en: hug rhymes with bug: bugs crawl, hugs warm.
normal.cn: hug 与 bug 押韵：虫子爬，拥抱暖。

normal.en: Short vowel before a single consonant doubles in -ed: hugged.
normal.cn: 短元音加单辅音，加 ed 时双写：hugged。

normal.en: give someone a hug is the everyday phrase.
normal.cn: give someone a hug 是日常说法。

normal.en: Hug it out means make peace with a hug.
normal.cn: hug it out 指用拥抱和好。

normal.en: Roads can hug a coast without any arms.
normal.cn: 道路 hug 海岸并不需要手臂。

abstract.en: Two arms drawing a full circle around someone.
abstract.cn: 双臂围出把人圈住的一个整圆。

abstract.en: A teddy bear squeezed flat against a sleepy chest.
abstract.cn: 玩具熊被压贴在困倦的胸口。

abstract.en: A cliff path pressed to the rock face.
abstract.cn: 崖边小路紧贴着岩壁。

examples.en: Lily ran out and gave her grandmother a big hug.
examples.cn: 莉莉跑出车站，给了祖母一个大大的拥抱。

examples.en: The two friends hugged before the train door closed.
examples.cn: 两位朋友在车门关闭前拥抱了。

examples.en: Mom's hugs always make the fear smaller.
examples.cn: 妈妈的拥抱总能把恐惧变小。

sensesIntro.en: The senses stretch from embracing people to clutching things, roads clinging to coasts, and the noun of comfort.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从拥抱人延伸到紧抱物、道路贴岸，再到名词的安慰。

core.cn: 核心意象：双臂合拢围住肩膀。

Arms tight around a thing.
Something pressed close along a line.
The act itself as a noun.

branches.cn: 拥抱是全身给予的安慰。

The team's best hugger is the captain.
items.exampleCN: 队里最爱拥抱的是队长。

items.example: The kitten cuddled into her scarf.
He clasped the railing in the wind.

items.meaning: to settle a quarrel with a hug

items.example: The school embraced the new plan.
items.exampleCN: 学校欣然接受了新方案。

definition_en: to be in a flat resting position, or to say something untrue
scene: 午后的草坡上，风筝线在头顶轻轻颤。After the picnic, we lay on the warm grass and watched clouds drift by.
sceneCN: 这里 lie 是「躺」（第 1 个义项：身体平放休息）；句意为野餐后我们躺在暖草上看云飘过。

derivatives.zh: 由 lie 加 -ar 构成，义为「说谎的人」
同形易混词，义为「放置；下蛋」
由 lie 加 -ing 构成，义为「说谎；躺卧的」

senses.title: To be flat and resting
senses.definition: to be in a flat position on a surface
senses.definitionCN: 在平面上呈平放的姿势
senses.example: After the picnic, we lay on the warm grass and watched clouds drift by.
senses.exampleCN: 野餐后我们躺在暖草上看云飘过。
senses.why: The core image is a body flat on grass, so resting comes first.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是平躺在草地上的身体，最基本的义项就是躺卧。

senses.title: To be located somewhere
senses.definition: to be in a particular place or position
senses.example: The old lighthouse lies on the eastern point of the island.
senses.exampleCN: 古老的灯塔坐落在岛的东角。
senses.why: Resting things do not move, so places rest in position too.
senses.whyCN: 躺着的物体不动，地点也「安卧」于某处。

senses.title: To say something untrue
senses.definition: to make a false statement on purpose
senses.example: He lied about finishing his homework, and the empty page showed it.
senses.exampleCN: 他谎称写完了作业，空白的本子暴露了一切。
senses.why: A different sense grew beside the resting one and stole the spelling.
senses.whyCN: 另一个义项在躺卧义旁长出并占用了同一拼写。

senses.title: A false statement as a noun
senses.definition: something said that is not true
senses.example: One small lie grew into a whole tangled story.
senses.exampleCN: 一个小谎长成一整团乱麻般的故事。
senses.why: The act becomes the false thing itself.
senses.whyCN: 行为本身变成假的那个东西。

senses.title: To be in a state
senses.definition: to be in a specified condition
senses.example: The matter lies with the principal now.
senses.exampleCN: 事情现在取决于校长。
senses.why: What rests somewhere also rests in a state.
senses.whyCN: 安卧在某地之物也「安处」于某种状态。

intro.en: Two old words share the spelling lie: one means to rest, one means to falsify.
intro.cn: 两个古老的词共享 lie 的拼写：一个指躺卧，一个指说假话。

items.en: The Germanic root lig- meant to lie down.
items.cn: 日耳曼语根 lig- 意为躺下。

items.en: Old English licgan carried the resting sense.
items.cn: 古英语 licgan 承载躺卧义。

items.en: A separate Germanic root leug- meant falsehood.
items.cn: 另一个日耳曼语根 leug- 意为虚假。

items.en: Old English leogan carried the lying sense.
items.cn: 古英语 leogan 承载说谎义。

items.en: Modern English kept both verbs under one spelling, splitting their past forms.
items.cn: 现代英语让两个动词共用一个拼写，但过去式分开。

note.en: The hard part is lie versus lay: lie needs no object, lay needs one.
note.cn: 难点是 lie 与 lay：lie 不接宾语，lay 必须接宾语。

entries.definition: to put something down or produce eggs

entries.definitionCN: 两个义项共用的现在分词

entries.definition: to relax by lying or sitting
to lean back in a resting position

entries.definitionCN: 篡改事实，侧重造假行为

normalIntro.en: These hooks separate the two meanings and the tricky past forms.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想区分两个词义与易错过去式。

normal.en: lie–lay–lain for resting; lie–lied–lied for fibbing.
normal.cn: 躺卧用 lie–lay–lain；说谎用 lie–lied–lied。

normal.en: lay needs an object: lay the book down; lie needs none.
normal.cn: lay 要宾语：lay the book down；lie 不用。

normal.en: liar is the person who lies.
normal.cn: liar 是说谎的人。

normal.en: A white lie is a small kind fib.
normal.cn: white lie 是善意的小谎。

normal.en: The lighthouse lies on the point: place sense.
normal.cn: 灯塔 lies on the point：位置义。

abstract.cn: 身体平摊在草地上，望着云。

abstract.en: A candle lying sideways on the windowsill.
abstract.cn: 蜡烛侧躺在窗台上。

abstract.en: A tangled ball of string: one lie pulling another.
abstract.cn: 一团缠乱的线：一个谎扯出另一个。

examples.cn: 野餐后我们躺在暖草上看云飘过。

examples.cn: 古老的灯塔坐落在岛的东角。

examples.en: Lying in the sun, the cat looked utterly content.
examples.cn: 猫躺在阳光下，一副心满意足的样子。

items.meaning: to put down; needs an object
items.example: Lay the map on the desk.

items.meaning: a thickness spread over a surface

items.exampleCN: 信任是整笔交易的基础。

items.example: Rest your legs after the climb.
She reclined in the deck chair.
A kind fib spared her feelings.
items.exampleCN: 善意的谎言护住了她的感受。

definition_en: by good luck; happening in a fortunate way
core_image: 雨云移开露出的一线阳光
scene: 野餐布刚铺好，远处的乌云压了过来。Luckily, the wind pushed the rain clouds away before lunch.
sceneCN: 这里 luckily 是「幸好」（第 1 个义项：以幸运的方式发生）；句意为幸好风在午饭前把雨云吹散了。

derivatives.zh: 由 luck 加 -y 构成，义为「幸运的」
基础名词，义为「运气」
由 lucky 加 -ness 构成，义为「幸运」

senses.title: By good fortune
senses.definition: as good luck would have it
senses.example: Luckily, the wind pushed the rain clouds away before lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 幸好风在午饭前把雨云吹散了。
senses.why: The core image is a sunbeam breaking through, so relief comes first.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是云开一线阳光，最基本的义项就是庆幸。

senses.title: Marking relief after risk
senses.definition: used to show a bad result was avoided
senses.example: Luckily, the bus was two minutes late, so we caught it.
senses.exampleCN: 万幸公交车晚了两分钟，我们赶上了。
senses.why: The beam matters because the storm was near.
senses.whyCN: 正因为风暴逼近，那道光才可贵。

senses.title: Opening a fortunate report
senses.definition: used to begin news of a happy outcome
senses.example: Luckily, the lost dog came home by itself.
senses.exampleCN: 所幸走失的狗自己回了家。
senses.why: The adverb hangs like a curtain before the glad news.
senses.whyCN: 副词如帷幕挂在喜讯之前。

intro.en: Luckily rides on the old gambling word luck with the adverb ending.
intro.cn: luckily 建立在古老的 luck 之上，加上副词词尾。

items.en: Old Norse lukka meant chance or fortune.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 lukka 意为机会、运气。

items.en: Middle English lucke entered from northern speech.
items.cn: 中古英语 lucke 由北方方言进入。

items.en: Modern English luck named both good and bad fortune.
items.cn: 现代英语 luck 兼指好运与霉运。

items.en: Lucky formed with the pet ending -y.
items.cn: lucky 以爱称词尾 -y 构成。

items.en: Luckily took the adverb ending for sentence use.
items.cn: luckily 加副词词尾用于句首句中。

note.en: The luck family shares the u sound; the near words differ in certainty of the good result.
note.cn: luck 词族共享 u 音；近义词的差异在于好结果的确定程度。

entries.definitionCN: 幸运的，由 luck 加 -y 构成

entries.definition: chance that brings good or bad

normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于 luck 词族与句法习惯。

normal.en: luck + -y = lucky; lucky + -ly = luckily.
normal.cn: luck 加 y 成 lucky，lucky 加 ly 成 luckily。

normal.en: Luckily usually sits at the start of a sentence.
normal.cn: luckily 常置于句首。

normal.en: Luckily for us adds who benefits.
normal.cn: luckily for us 点明受益者。

normal.en: Luckily often introduces news that dodges trouble.
normal.cn: luckily 常引出躲过麻烦的消息。

normal.en: Fortune is the formal cousin of luck.
normal.cn: fortune 是 luck 的正式亲戚。

abstract.en: A sunbeam slicing through a torn cloud.
abstract.cn: 阳光从云缝里切进来。

abstract.en: A hand catching a falling cup just in time.
abstract.cn: 一只手在杯子坠地前接住它。

abstract.en: A gate swinging open right as you arrive.
abstract.cn: 你刚到，门恰好开了。

examples.en: Luckily, the wind pushed the rain clouds away before lunch.
examples.cn: 幸好风在午饭前把雨云吹散了。

examples.en: Luckily for us, the museum stayed open late.
examples.cn: 幸运的是，博物馆延迟闭馆。

examples.en: She tripped but luckily landed on the soft mat.
examples.cn: 她绊了一下，幸好落在软垫上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 拉克利 」——luck 谐音「拉客」，出租车拉客全靠运气，luckily 就是「运气好」。

root: luckily 由 luck 加 -y 构成 lucky，再加 -ly 构成副词；luck 源自古诺斯语 lukka（机会、运气），经中古英语北方方言进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from plain good fortune to relief after danger and to openings of good news.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sunlight breaking through parting clouds.
core.cn: 核心意象：拨云见日的一线阳光。

branches.en: Happening by good luck.
Relief that a bad result was avoided.
The opener of a happy report.
The smaller the margin, the bigger the luck.
Relief stories almost always start with luckily.
branches.cn: 庆幸的故事几乎都从 luckily 讲起。

intro.en: The luck family below shows the noun, the two endings, and near rivals.
intro.cn: 下列 luck 词族展示名词、两个词尾及近义对手。

items.example: They met by chance at the pier.

definition_zh: 夫人；女士；太太（对妇女的尊称）
definition_en: a polite way of addressing a woman
core_image: 酒店前台微微欠身的问候
scene: 酒店大堂的吊灯洒下暖光，前台放着宾客名单。Madam, your suite on the fifth floor is ready.
sceneCN: 这里 madam 是对妇女的尊称「夫人、女士」（第 1 个义项）；句意为女士，您五楼的套房已备好。

collocations.zh: 敬启者（信件中对女士的称呼）

derivatives.zh: 法语借词拼法，义为「夫人」
法语借词，义为「小姐」
madam 的口语缩略，义为「女士」

senses.title: A polite address to a woman
senses.definition: a respectful word for addressing a woman
senses.example: Madam, your suite on the fifth floor is ready.
senses.exampleCN: 女士，您五楼的套房已备好。
senses.why: The core image is the slight bow at the front desk, so respect comes first.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是前台微微欠身，最基本的义项就是敬意。

senses.title: A formal letter opening
senses.definition: a formal salutation to an unknown woman
senses.definitionCN: 对不知名女士的正式信件称呼
senses.example: Dear Madam, thank you for your letter of May the third.
senses.exampleCN: 尊敬的女士，感谢您五月三日的来信。
senses.why: Spoken respect becomes written respect.
senses.whyCN: 口头的敬意转为纸上的敬意。

senses.title: A woman in charge
senses.definition: a woman who leads a household or staff
senses.definitionCN: 掌管家政或团队的女性
senses.example: The whole crew obeys the madam of the theater.
senses.exampleCN: 全剧组都听剧场女主管的。
senses.why: Respect follows the person who commands the room.
senses.whyCN: 敬意追随掌权之人。

intro.en: Madam is French madame worn smooth by English speech.
intro.cn: madam 是法语 madame 被英语语音磨圆的结果。

items.en: Latin mea domina meant my lady, my mistress.
items.cn: 拉丁语 mea domina 意为我的女主人。

items.en: Old French ma dame carried the same honorific sense.
items.cn: 古法语 ma dame 承载同样的敬称义。

items.en: French madame became the standard honorific.
items.cn: 法语 madame 成为标准敬称。

items.en: Middle English madame or madam entered with courtly speech.
items.cn: 中古英语 madame 或 madam 随宫廷用语进入。

items.en: Modern English shortened it in speech to ma'am.
items.cn: 现代英语在口语中缩略为 ma'am。

note.en: The honorific family splits by language and by gender; pick by setting, not by meaning alone.
note.cn: 敬称词族按语言与性别分野；按场合选词，而非只看词义。

entries.definition: a woman of refinement or title
the title for a married woman
a neutral title for any woman

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the French family and the spoken short form.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于法语词族与口语缩略。

normal.en: madam is sir's mirror: Dear Sir or Dear Madam.
normal.cn: madam 与 sir 成对：Dear Sir or Dear Madam。

normal.en: ma'am is madam spoken fast.
normal.cn: ma'am 是 madam 的快速口语。

normal.en: madame keeps the French tail e.
normal.cn: madame 保留法语尾音 e。

normal.en: mademoiselle once meant an unmarried lady.
normal.cn: mademoiselle 旧指未婚小姐。

normal.en: Dear Madam opens letters when the name is unknown.
normal.cn: 不知姓名时用 Dear Madam 开信。

abstract.en: A gloved hand lifted from a carriage step.
abstract.cn: 马车踏板上抬起一只戴手套的手。

abstract.en: A bow at the front desk, keys laid on marble.
abstract.cn: 前台欠身，钥匙搁在大理石台上。

abstract.en: A letter folded with Dear Madam on the first line.
abstract.cn: 信纸首行写着 Dear Madam。

examples.en: Madam, your suite on the fifth floor is ready.
examples.cn: 女士，您五楼的套房已备好。

examples.en: Dear Madam, your order will ship this Friday.
examples.cn: 尊敬的女士，您的订单将于本周五发货。

examples.en: Yes, madam, I will bring the menu at once.
examples.cn: 是的，女士，我马上把菜单送来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 抹德姆 」——发音像「抹的」？贵妇脸上抹的粉最讲究，尊称一声夫人，madam。

root: madam 源自拉丁语 mea domina（我的女主人），经古法语 ma dame、法语 madame 进入中古英语，口语缩略为 ma'am。

sensesIntro.en: The senses move from spoken respect to written salutation and to the woman in charge.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从口头敬意移向书面称呼，再到当家女性。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a slight bow of respect before a woman.
core.cn: 核心意象：向女士微微欠身致意。

branches.en: A respectful spoken address.
A formal letter salutation.
A woman who leads a house or staff.
Spoken bow and written bow share one word.
branches.cn: 口头与纸面的欠身同用一词。

branches.en: Respect flows both to rank and to age.
branches.cn: 敬意既予职位，也予年长。

intro.cn: 下列敬称词族将 madam 与法语亲属及英语对手并列。

definition_zh: 数学；算术（mathematics 的口语缩略）
definition_en: the study of numbers, shapes, and quantities
core_image: 黑板上一排整齐的算式
scene: 数学课的铃声刚落，黑板上留着未擦的竖式。Math class ended with a race to solve the last problem.
sceneCN: 这里 math 是「数学」（第 1 个义项：研究数、形与量的学问）；句意为数学课以一场解题竞赛收尾。

derivatives.zh: 正式全称，义为「数学」
由 mathematics 加 -al 构成，义为「数学的」
由 mathematics 加 -ician 构成，义为「数学家」

senses.title: The subject of numbers and shapes
senses.definition: the school subject dealing with numbers and space
senses.definitionCN: 学校里研究数与形的科目
senses.example: Math class ended with a race to solve the last problem.
senses.exampleCN: 数学课以一场解题竞赛收尾。
senses.why: The core image is chalk lines on the board, so the subject sense comes first.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是黑板上的粉笔算式，最基本的义项就是学科。

senses.title: Calculation itself
senses.definition: the act of working out numbers
senses.definitionCN: 动笔或动脑算数的行为
senses.example: Do the math: three buses, sixty students, no room left.
senses.exampleCN: 算一算：三辆巴士，六十名学生，没有空位了。
senses.why: The subject narrows to the figuring itself.
senses.whyCN: 学科收窄为演算本身。

senses.title: Math as a way of thinking
senses.definition: precise logical reasoning about quantities
senses.definitionCN: 对数量做精确推理的思维方式
senses.example: Her math is careful, so her bridges never wobble.
senses.exampleCN: 她的计算严谨，所以建的桥从不晃动。
senses.why: Numbers discipline the mind that uses them.
senses.whyCN: 数字磨砺使用它的大脑。

intro.en: Math is mathematics clipped for everyday talk, and the Greek root already meant learning.
intro.cn: math 是 mathematics 的口语裁剪，其希腊语根本义就是「学习所得」。

items.en: Greek mathēma meant a thing learned, especially science.
items.cn: 希腊语 mathēma 意为所学之物，尤指科学。

items.en: The root manthan- meant to learn.
items.cn: 词根 manthan- 意为学习。

items.en: Latin mathematica carried the subject into scholarship.
items.cn: 拉丁语 mathematica 把学科带入学术。

items.en: French mathématiques passed it to English books.
items.cn: 法语 mathématiques 将其传入英语书籍。

items.en: Modern English clipped mathematics to math in America and maths in Britain.
items.cn: 现代英语在美国裁剪为 math，在英国为 maths。

note.en: All three labels name one subject; register decides which one you write.
note.cn: 三个名称指同一学科；按语体决定写哪一个。

entries.definition: the math of shapes and space
the math of symbols and equations

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the clipping habit and the Greek root.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于缩略习惯与希腊语根。

normal.en: math is mathematics with the tail cut off.
normal.cn: math 是 mathematics 去尾的裁剪。

normal.en: British maths keeps the s, American math drops it.
normal.cn: 英式 maths 带 s，美式 math 不带。

normal.en: math + -ematician = mathematician, the number expert.
normal.cn: mathematics 加 -ician 构成 mathematician。

normal.en: Do the math means figure out the answer yourself.
normal.cn: do the math 指自己算明白。

normal.en: The Greek root meant learning, so math is learned skill.
normal.cn: 希腊语根义为学习，math 即所学之技。

abstract.en: Chalk digits marching in straight columns.
abstract.cn: 粉笔数字排成笔直的纵列。

abstract.en: A ruler and compass resting on squared paper.
abstract.cn: 方格纸上搁着直尺与圆规。

abstract.en: A staircase of sums climbing the blackboard.
abstract.cn: 一道道算式如阶梯爬满黑板。

examples.en: Math class ended with a race to solve the last problem.
examples.cn: 数学课以一场解题竞赛收尾。

examples.en: She won the math prize at the school fair.
examples.cn: 她在校园集市上得了数学奖。

examples.en: Do the math before you promise the schedule.
examples.cn: 答应时间表之前先算一算。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 麦斯 」——发音像「算得快的人了不起」，math 就是让人又爱又怕的数学。

root: math 为 mathematics 的口语缩略；mathematics 源自希腊语 mathēma（所学之物），词根 manthan-（学习），经拉丁语 mathematica、法语 mathématiques 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the school subject to bare calculation and to the habit of precise thought.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从学校科目走向单纯的运算，再到精确思考的习惯。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: chalk equations marching across a blackboard.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑板上排开的粉笔算式。

branches.en: The subject of numbers, shapes, and quantity.
The act of working out figures.
Precise reasoning as a habit of mind.
branches.cn: 作为思维习惯的精确推理。

branches.en: The subject trains the mind it names.
branches.cn: 这门学科锻炼以它为名的心智。

branches.en: Every proof is calculation grown patient.
branches.cn: 每个证明都是耐心的演算。

intro.cn: 下列条目以希腊「学习」词根贯通 math 与其全称及分支。

definition_en: a shallow metal container used for frying or cooking food
core_image: 灶台上滋滋作响的平底锅
scene: 清晨的厨房里，油花在锅底跳。Mother cracked two eggs into the pan and started breakfast.
sceneCN: 这里 pan 是「平底锅」（第 1 个义项：浅口金属烹调用具）；句意为妈妈往平底锅里打了两个鸡蛋，开始做早餐。

derivatives.zh: 复合词，义为「煎锅」
由 sauce 加 pan 构成，义为「深平底锅；炖锅」
由 pan 加 cake 构成，义为「薄煎饼」

senses.title: A shallow cooking container
senses.definition: a shallow metal container for frying food
senses.example: Mother cracked two eggs into the pan and started breakfast.
senses.exampleCN: 妈妈往平底锅里打了两个鸡蛋，开始做早餐。
senses.why: The core image is oil sizzling on flat metal, so the cookware sense comes first.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是平底金属上滋滋的油花，最基本的义项就是烹调用具。

senses.title: A similar open container
senses.definition: any open, dish-shaped container
senses.example: Use a pan under the leak to catch the dripping water.
senses.exampleCN: 在漏水处下面放个盆接水。
senses.why: A dish that catches things borrows the pan shape.
senses.whyCN: 承接之物的盘形借用了锅的形状。

senses.title: To wash soil for gold
senses.definition: to wash gravel in a pan to find gold
senses.definitionCN: 用淘盘淘洗砂砾找金子
senses.example: The old miner panned the river gravel for gold.
senses.exampleCN: 老矿工在河砂里淘金。
senses.why: The shape names the work done with it.
senses.whyCN: 器物之名转指用器物做的事。

senses.title: To criticize harshly
senses.definition: to review a play or film very negatively
senses.definitionCN: 对戏剧或电影作极差的评价
senses.example: The critics panned the new comedy without mercy.
senses.exampleCN: 评论家毫不留情地批评了这部新喜剧。
senses.why: Smashing metal pans suggests smashing a work with words.
senses.whyCN: 砸锅的响声联想为用文字把作品砸烂。

intro.en: Pan is one of the oldest kitchen words, carried into English by Germanic speech.
intro.cn: pan 是最古老的厨房词汇之一，经日耳曼语进入英语。

items.en: Germanic languages kept a common word pann- for flat vessels.
items.cn: 日耳曼诸语保留了表示扁容器的共同词 pann-。

items.en: Old English panne named both pots and dishes.
items.cn: 古英语 panne 兼指锅与盘。

items.en: The Germanic word probably came from Latin patina, a broad dish.
items.cn: 该日耳曼词可能源自拉丁语 patina，意为宽盘。

items.en: Middle English pan covered cookware and basin senses.
items.cn: 中古英语 pan 兼有炊具与盆义。

items.en: Modern English pan added gold-washing and harsh-criticism uses.
items.cn: 现代英语 pan 又添淘金与严厉批评的用法。

note.en: The pan family shares the flat shape; the near words differ by depth and use.
note.cn: pan 词族共享扁形容器意象；近义词的差异在深浅与用途。

entries.definitionCN: 煎锅，由 frying 加 pan 构成

entries.definition: a deeper pan with a handle
a flat cake cooked in a pan

normal.cn: pan 与 fan 押韵：风扇降温，平底锅做饭。

normal.en: pan + cake = pancake, the flat cake in a pan.
normal.cn: pan 加 cake 构成 pancake，锅里摊的饼。

normal.en: A saucepan holds sauce; a frying pan fries.
normal.cn: saucepan 盛酱汁，frying pan 用来煎。

normal.en: Pan for gold borrows the dish shape.
normal.cn: pan for gold 借用盘子的形状指淘金。

normal.en: Critics pan films like banging pans, loudly and flat.
normal.cn: 影评人 pan 电影如同敲锅，又响又扁的差评。

abstract.en: Oil sizzling in a circle of flat steel.
abstract.cn: 圆形平钢上一圈滋滋的油花。

abstract.en: Golden flakes swirling in a water-filled dish.
abstract.cn: 水盘中旋转的金砂。

abstract.en: A review as flat and loud as a pan dropped.
abstract.cn: 差评像摔在地上的平底锅一样响亮干脆。

examples.en: Mother cracked two eggs into the pan and started breakfast.

examples.en: The chef heated a large pan over the flame.
examples.cn: 厨师在火上烧热一口大锅。

examples.en: Old miners panned for gold in this river.
examples.cn: 老矿工们曾在这条河里淘金。

Bacon crisps in the frying pan.

items.meaning: a deep pan with a handle

items.meaning: a flat cake cooked in a pan

Patina is the old ancestor of pan.

items.meaning: a flat metal sheet for the oven

definition_en: to forgive someone or officially free them from punishment
core_image: 微微欠身递出的免罚文书
scene: 法庭的长廊安静下来，书记员捧起文书。The governor pardoned the prisoner after ten long years.
sceneCN: 这里 pardon 是「赦免」（第 1 个义项：官方免除惩罚）；句意为十年之后，州长赦免了那名囚犯。

derivatives.zh: 由 pardon 加 -able 构成，义为「可原谅的」
由 un- 加 pardonable 构成，义为「不可原谅的」
近义动词，义为「原谅」

senses.title: To officially cancel a punishment
senses.definition: to officially free someone from a legal punishment
senses.definitionCN: 以官方名义免除法律惩罚
senses.example: The governor pardoned the prisoner after ten long years.
senses.exampleCN: 十年之后，州长赦免了那名囚犯。
senses.why: The core image is a paper that lifts the sentence, so the official sense leads.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是免除刑罚的文书，最基本的义项就是官方赦免。

senses.title: To forgive a wrong
senses.definition: to forgive a fault or offense
senses.example: She pardoned her brother for breaking the vase.
senses.exampleCN: 她原谅了弟弟打碎花瓶。
senses.why: The legal lifting of guilt becomes a personal one.
senses.whyCN: 法律上的免罪变成私人的宽恕。

senses.title: A polite request to repeat
senses.definition: a polite way of asking someone to repeat
senses.definitionCN: 礼貌地请对方重复所说的话
senses.example: Pardon? I did not catch your name.
senses.exampleCN: 您说什么？我没听清你的名字。
senses.why: Asking forgiveness for not hearing softens the request.
senses.whyCN: 为「没听清」请求原谅，把重复的要求说软了。

senses.title: A polite apology
senses.definition: a polite way of saying sorry for a small fault
senses.example: Pardon me, I did not mean to step on your foot.
senses.exampleCN: 对不起，我不是故意踩您的脚。
senses.why: The request for forgiveness turns into the apology itself.
senses.whyCN: 请求宽恕的话本身成了道歉语。

intro.en: Pardon carries the Latin idea of giving a gift of forgiveness completely.
intro.cn: pardon 携带拉丁语「完全给予宽恕之礼」的观念。

items.en: Latin per meant thoroughly and donare meant to give.
items.cn: 拉丁语 per 意为彻底，donare 意为给予。

items.en: The combined idea was to give remission fully.
items.cn: 合起来的观念是「完全给予宽免」。

items.en: Old French pardon became the verb to forgive.
items.cn: 古法语 pardon 成为宽恕动词。

items.en: Middle English pardonen carried both forgiving and legal release.
items.cn: 中古英语 pardonen 兼指宽恕与法律释放。

items.en: Modern English pardon added the polite repeat-and-apology uses.
items.cn: 现代英语 pardon 又添礼貌请重复与致歉的用法。

note.en: The pardon family shares the give root; the near words differ in warmth and law.
note.cn: pardon 词族共享「给」的词根；近义词的差异在温度与法律色彩。

entries.definitionCN: 可原谅的，由 pardon 加 -able 构成
不可原谅的，加否定前缀构成
名词复数或第三人称形式

entries.definition: to overlook a small fault politely
an official act of forgiveness for many

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the give root and the polite phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于词根与礼貌用语。

normal.en: pardon = per + don: a thorough gift of forgiveness.
normal.cn: pardon = per + don：彻底给予的宽恕之礼。

normal.en: Beg your pardon doubles as a repeat request.
normal.cn: beg your pardon 兼作请再讲一遍。

normal.en: Don in pardon is the same don as in donate.
normal.cn: pardon 里的 don 与 donate（捐赠）同根。

normal.en: A pardon paper lifts a sentence like a hand lifts a weight.
normal.cn: 赦免文书卸下刑罚，如手卸下重物。

normal.en: Pardon me softens bumping into people.
normal.cn: pardon me 让撞到人时的道歉更客气。

abstract.en: A paper with a red seal lifting chains off wrists.
abstract.cn: 盖红印的文书让手腕上的铁链落下。

abstract.en: A hand waving away a small stumble.
abstract.cn: 一只手挥去小小过失。

abstract.en: A lean forward and a raised eyebrow asking for repeat.
abstract.cn: 微微前倾、抬眉请人再讲一遍。

examples.en: The governor pardoned the prisoner after ten long years.
examples.cn: 十年之后，州长赦免了那名囚犯。

examples.en: Beg your pardon, could you say that again more slowly?
examples.cn: 不好意思，您能再慢一点说一遍吗？

examples.en: Please pardon my late reply to your letter.
examples.cn: 请原谅我回信晚了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 帕顿 」——像「啪！顿一下」，撞到人先停一「顿」，说声 pardon 请原谅。

sensesIntro.en: The senses move from legal release to personal forgiveness and to polite repeat-and-apology formulas.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从法律赦免走向个人原谅，再到礼貌的请重复与致歉套语。

core.cn: 核心意象：一纸免除刑罚的文书。

A polite request to repeat words.

intro.cn: 下列条目以「给」的词根贯通 pardon 与其同根词。

The delay was pardonable in the storm.
items.exampleCN: 暴风雨中的迟到情有可原。

They donate books to the library.
The donor wished to stay unknown.
The captain showed mercy to the crew.

definition_en: one part in every hundred; expressed by the symbol %
core_image: 被切成一百小块的完整圆
scene: 班会的黑板上画着一块大圆饼图，粉笔字写下调查结果。Twenty percent of the students walk to school every day.
sceneCN: 这里 percent 是「百分比」（第 1 个义项：每一百份中的一份）；句意为百分之二十的学生每天步行上学。

derivatives.zh: 由 percent 加 -age 构成，义为「百分率；比例」
由 percent 加 -ile 构成，义为「百分位数」
拉丁语借语，义为「人均」

senses.title: Parts in each hundred
senses.definition: an amount in each hundred parts
senses.example: Twenty percent of the students walk to school every day.
senses.exampleCN: 百分之二十的学生每天步行上学。
senses.why: The core image is a whole cut into hundred slices, so the ratio sense leads.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是切成一百片的整体，最基本的义项就是比率。

senses.title: The symbol and its reading
senses.definition: the sign % with its spoken form
senses.definitionCN: 符号 % 及其口头读法
senses.example: Write sixty percent or use the sign for sixty percent.
senses.exampleCN: 写 sixty percent 或用符号表示百分之六十。
senses.why: The slice image gets a short written sign.
senses.whyCN: 切片意象获得一个简短的书写符号。

senses.title: A share of profit or interest
senses.definition: a share of money calculated by hundreds
senses.example: The agent takes ten percent of every ticket sold.
senses.exampleCN: 代理每卖出一张票抽成百分之十。
senses.why: Ratios of a whole become shares of money.
senses.whyCN: 整体的比率成为金钱的分成。

intro.en: Percent is a Latin phrase worn down to one word: per centum, by the hundred.
intro.cn: percent 是拉丁语短语 per centum（每百）磨损成的单词。

items.en: Latin centum meant a hundred.
items.cn: 拉丁语 centum 意为一百。

items.en: Medieval Latin merchants wrote per centum for rates.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语商人写作 per centum 表示比率。

items.en: Italian traders carried per cento across the Mediterranean.
items.cn: 意大利商人把 per cento 带过地中海。

items.en: English ledgers first wrote per cent in two words.
items.cn: 英语账册最初分作 per cent 两词书写。

items.en: Modern English fused it into percent and added the sign %.
items.cn: 现代英语合成 percent 并使用符号 %。

note.en: The hundred family shares the Latin cent; the near words differ in scope.
note.cn: 「百」词族共享拉丁词根 cent；近义词的差异在使用范围。

entries.definitionCN: 百分率，由 percent 加 -age 构成

entries.definition: a position on a hundred-point scale
a hundred years, from Latin centum

entries.definitionCN: 比率，泛指对比基准的量

entries.definition: a part considered against the whole
a part of a whole, often not out of hundred

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the cent root and the slice image.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于 cent 词根与切片意象。

normal.en: cent in percent is the same cent as in century and centimeter.
normal.cn: percent 里的 cent 与 century、centimeter 同根。

normal.en: percent = per + cent: for each hundred.
normal.cn: percent = per + cent：每一百份。

normal.en: The sign % looks like a tilted hundred with two small zeros.
normal.cn: 符号 % 像斜放的一百加两个小零。

normal.en: Percentage adds -age to name the measure itself.
normal.cn: percentage 加 -age 指比率本身。

normal.en: A hundred percent means the whole pie, nothing left.
normal.cn: 百分之百意味着整个圆，一块不剩。

abstract.en: A round pie cut into one hundred equal slices.
abstract.cn: 切成一百等份的圆饼。

abstract.en: Two tiny circles leaning beside a slash like coins.
abstract.cn: 斜杠旁倚着两枚小圆如硬币。

abstract.en: A ledger column filling from zero to hundred.
abstract.cn: 账册的格子从零填到一百。

examples.en: Twenty percent of the students walk to school every day.
examples.cn: 百分之二十的学生每天步行上学。

examples.en: House prices in the city rose by eight percent this year.
examples.cn: 今年该市房价上涨了百分之八。

examples.en: The battery is at ninety percent, so we can go on working.
examples.cn: 电量还剩百分之九十，可以继续工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 普森特 」——谐音「扑『伞』特」，伞面撑开像切满格的圆，每格是百分之一。

root: percent 源自拉丁语 per（每）+ centum（百），经中世纪拉丁 per centum、意大利语 per cento 进入英语，两词合一后专表百分比；centum 词根同见 century、centimeter。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from parts of a hundred to the written sign and to money shares.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从每百中的份额走向百分号与金钱分成。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole pie sliced into one hundred parts.
core.cn: 核心意象：切成一百份的完整圆饼。

branches.en: Parts counted out of a hundred.
The sign and its spoken reading.
A share of profit or interest.
The same slice math prices every share.
branches.cn: 同一套切分算术为分成定价。

branches.en: The sign is the slice made small enough to write.
branches.cn: 符号是被写小了的切片。

intro.cn: 下列条目以 cent 词根贯通 percent 与「百」家族。

items.meaning: a point on a hundred scale
items.example: She scored in the ninetieth percentile.
items.exampleCN: 她的成绩在第九十百分位。

items.example: The bridge is two centuries old.
The beetle is two centimeters long.

items.meaning: the middle value of a set

definition_en: a man whose job is to keep order and enforce the law
core_image: 路口指挥交通的挺拔身影
scene: 放学路口车流渐密，一声哨响稳住了车与孩子。The policeman stopped the traffic so the pupils could cross.
sceneCN: 这里 policeman 是「警察」（第 1 个义项：维护秩序的执法者）；句意为警察拦下车流，让小学生们过马路。

derivatives.zh: 基础名词，义为「警方；警察部门」
由 police 加 woman 构成，义为「女警察」
由 -man 变 -men 构成的不规则复数，义为「警察们」

senses.title: A man who enforces the law
senses.definition: a man employed to keep order and enforce the law
senses.definitionCN: 受雇维持秩序、执行法律的男性
senses.example: The policeman stopped the traffic so the pupils could cross.
senses.exampleCN: 警察拦下车流，让小学生们过马路。
senses.why: The core image is a straight figure at the crossing, so the officer sense comes first.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是路口挺拔的身影，最基本的义项就是执法者。

senses.title: The uniform as a symbol
senses.definition: the uniformed figure standing for the police force
senses.definitionCN: 代表警察队伍的制服形象
senses.example: Kids waved at the friendly policeman on the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们向街角友善的警察挥手。
senses.why: The person becomes the face of the whole force.
senses.whyCN: 个人成为整个警队的门面。

senses.title: A guardian in daily life
senses.definition: a helpful figure in neighborhood life
senses.definitionCN: 社区生活中的可靠帮手
senses.example: The old policeman next door checks the street lamps each night.
senses.exampleCN: 隔壁的老警察每晚查看路灯。
senses.why: Authority softened into neighborhood care.
senses.whyCN: 权威软化成街坊的照看。

intro.en: Policeman is police, the Greek word for city order, joined to a plain English man.
intro.cn: policeman 是表示「城市治理」的希腊词 police 加上朴素的英语 man。

items.en: Greek polis meant a city and its order.
items.cn: 希腊语 polis 意为城市及其秩序。

items.en: Politeia meant citizenship and administration.
items.cn: politeia 意为公民治理。

items.en: Latin politia passed the civic sense onward.
items.cn: 拉丁语 politia 传递了治理义。

items.en: French police named the city watch in the eighteen hundreds.
items.cn: 法语 police 在十九世纪前后指城市治安队伍。

items.en: English added man to make the street officer's title.
items.cn: 英语加 man 构成街头警员的称呼。

note.en: The police family shares the city-order root; forms differ by gender and number.
note.cn: police 词族共享「城市秩序」词根；形式按性别与数变化。

entries.definition: the police force as a whole
informal word for a police officer

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the compound build and the irregular plural.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于复合构词与不规则复数。

normal.en: policeman = police + man, a man of the police.
normal.cn: policeman = police + man：警队里的男性。

normal.en: man becomes men in the plural: policemen.
normal.cn: 复数时 man 变 men：policemen。

normal.en: police keeps the Greek polis, the city it guards.
normal.cn: police 保留希腊语 polis，即其守护的城市。

normal.en: policewoman is the female counterpart.
normal.cn: policewoman 是对应的女性称谓。

normal.en: Say officer in formal news, cop in casual talk.
normal.cn: 正式新闻说 officer，口语说 cop。

abstract.en: A straight figure with a raised palm at a crossing.
abstract.cn: 路口举起手掌的挺拔身影。

abstract.en: A whistle cutting through morning traffic noise.
abstract.cn: 哨声划破清晨的车流声。

abstract.en: A blue cap nodding to schoolchildren.
abstract.cn: 蓝帽下的头向小学生点头。

examples.en: The policeman stopped the traffic so the pupils could cross.
examples.cn: 警察拦下车流，让小学生们过马路。

examples.en: A kind policeman helped the lost child find her mother.
examples.cn: 一位好心的警察帮走失的孩子找到了妈妈。

examples.en: Two policemen guarded the gate all night.
examples.cn: 两名警察整夜守着大门。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 普里斯曼 」——police（警队）+ man（男人），警队男人就是男警察。

sensesIntro.cn: 义项从执法者走向制服象征，再到街坊守护者。

definition_en: a large printed sheet put in public places to advertise or decorate
core_image: 墙上贴出的那张大图画
scene: 走廊公告栏前围满了看展讯的学生。The poster of the school art show covered the whole board.
sceneCN: 这里 poster 是「海报」（第 1 个义项：张贴的大幅宣传画）；句意为学校艺术展的海报贴满了整块公告栏。

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「张贴；邮寄」
复合词，义为「海报板；广告牌」
近义复合词，义为「大型广告牌」

senses.title: A printed sheet for public display
senses.definition: a large printed notice or picture for public walls
senses.definitionCN: 贴在公共墙面上的大幅印刷品
senses.example: The poster of the school art show covered the whole board.
senses.exampleCN: 学校艺术展的海报贴满了整块公告栏。
senses.why: The core image is one big sheet on a wall, so the display sense leads.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是墙上的一张大纸，最基本的义项就是张贴画。

senses.title: A picture for decoration
senses.definition: a large picture hung or pinned for decoration
senses.definitionCN: 钉挂起来装饰房间的大幅图画
senses.example: A band poster hangs above his desk.
senses.exampleCN: 他书桌上方挂着一张乐队海报。
senses.why: The public display moves into a private room.
senses.whyCN: 公共张贴走进私人房间。

senses.title: The person who posts
senses.definition: someone who posts notices or mail
senses.definitionCN: 张贴告示或投递邮件的人
senses.example: Old texts used poster for the worker who put up bills.
senses.exampleCN: 旧时文本用 poster 指张贴告示的工人。
senses.why: The verb post names the doer with -er.
senses.whyCN: 动词 post 加 -er 指做张贴的人。

intro.cn: poster 直接生长自 post，即把告示钉在众人可见处的动作。

items.en: Latin ponere meant to place or put.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ponere 意为放置。

items.en: The past participle positum gave the placing root.
items.cn: 过去分词 positum 提供了「放置」词根。

items.en: Old French poster meant to fasten with a post or stake.
items.cn: 古法语 poster 意为用柱桩固定。

items.en: English post named both the stake and the mailed letter.
items.cn: 英语 post 兼指桩柱与邮寄的信件。

items.en: Modern English poster named the large printed notice.
items.cn: 现代英语 poster 指大幅印刷告示。

note.en: The post family shares the placing root; the near words differ by size and place.
note.cn: post 词族共享「放置」词根；近义词的差异在尺寸与张贴处。

abstract.en: A giant sheet of color swallowing a gray wall.

abstract.en: Four pins holding a band photo above a desk.

abstract.en: A passersby crowd pausing before one bright sheet.

examples.en: The poster of the school art show covered the whole board.
examples.cn: 学校艺术展的海报贴满了整块公告栏。

examples.en: Students designed posters to welcome the new term.
examples.cn: 学生们设计了海报欢迎新学期。

examples.cn: 她买了一张灯塔主题的复古海报。

The wall is covered with posters.
A billboard towers over the highway.
They raised placards at the march.

Check your position on the map.

definition_en: a set of instructions for preparing food, or a way to achieve something
core_image: 灶台边摊开的那页做法清单
scene: 厨房里飘着黄油香，奶奶翻着一本旧笔记。Grandma shared her secret recipe for apple pie.
sceneCN: 这里 recipe 是「食谱」（第 1 个义项：做菜的步骤说明）；句意为奶奶分享了她做苹果派的秘方。

derivatives.zh: 复合词，义为「食谱书」
同根词（receive 家族），义为「接受者」
同根易混词，义为「收据」

senses.title: Instructions for cooking
senses.definition: a written set of steps for preparing a dish
senses.example: Grandma shared her secret recipe for apple pie.
senses.exampleCN: 奶奶分享了她做苹果派的秘方。
senses.why: The core image is a page of steps beside the stove, so the cooking sense leads.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是灶边摊开的一页步骤，最基本的义项就是食谱。

senses.title: A method for achieving something
senses.definition: a way of getting a desired result
senses.example: Patience is a recipe for calmer mornings.
senses.exampleCN: 耐心是换来清晨从容的诀窍。
senses.why: Cooking steps widen into life methods.
senses.whyCN: 烹饪步骤扩展为处世方法。

senses.title: A medical prescription, old use
senses.definition: a doctor's written instruction, old sense
senses.example: Old pharmacy books kept recipes for cough syrups.
senses.exampleCN: 旧药房手册保存着止咳糖浆的配方。
senses.why: The written formula served kitchens and sickrooms alike.
senses.whyCN: 同一张书面配方既进厨房也进药房。

intro.en: Recipe begins as the Latin word take, the first word doctors wrote on prescriptions.
intro.cn: recipe 本是拉丁语「取」，是医生处方上写的第一个词。

items.en: Latin recipere meant to take or receive.
items.cn: 拉丁语 recipere 意为取、接受。

items.en: Recipe, imperative of recipere, opened each prescription: take.
items.cn: recipere 的命令式 recipe，作处方开头：取。

items.en: Medical recipes listed ingredients after the imperative.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁医学方在命令式后列出成分。

items.en: French recette carried both cookery and medicine uses.
items.cn: 法语 recette 兼用于烹饪与医药。

items.en: English recipe settled on cooking, keeping a motto sense in recipes for life.
items.cn: 英语 recipe 定位于烹饪，又以 recipes for life 保留格言式用法。

note.en: The take root links recipe with the receive family; the near words differ by field.
note.cn: 「取」词根把 recipe 与 receive 家族相连；近义词的差异在领域。

entries.definition: a doctor's written order for medicine

entries.definitionCN: 菜单，点菜清单而非做法

normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于「取」词根与厨房纸页。

normal.en: Recipe is Latin for take: take the eggs, take the flour.
normal.cn: recipe 是拉丁语「取」：取鸡蛋，取面粉。

normal.en: Recipe and receipt share one root; one feeds you, one proves you paid.
normal.cn: recipe 与 receipt 同根：一个喂饱你，一个证明你付了钱。

normal.en: Recipes list steps in order, like a game walkthrough.
normal.cn: 食谱按顺序列步骤，像游戏攻略。

normal.en: A recipe for success is the figurative use.
normal.cn: a recipe for success 是比喻用法。

normal.en: Grandma's secret recipe hides one extra spoon.
normal.cn: 奶奶的秘方总多藏一勺料。

abstract.en: A flour-dusted page propped by a jar.
abstract.cn: 沾了面粉的一页被罐子支着。

abstract.en: Numbered steps climbing down the paper like a ladder.
abstract.cn: 纸上的编号如阶梯层层而下。

abstract.en: A ladle resting where the last step ends.
abstract.cn: 汤勺停在最后一步的尽头。

examples.en: Grandma shared her secret recipe for apple pie.
examples.cn: 奶奶分享了她做苹果派的秘方。

examples.en: Follow the recipe and add the eggs one by one.
examples.cn: 照食谱做，一个个地加入鸡蛋。

examples.en: Hard work plus rest is a good recipe for study.
examples.cn: 努力加休息是学习的好方法。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 蕊丝扑必 」——谐音「如‘是’步骤，必照做」，食谱一步一步必须照做。

root: recipe 源自拉丁语 recipere（取、接受）的命令式 recipe（取），为中世纪处方起首语；同根词有 receipt（收据）、recipient（接受者），现代英语定位于「烹饪步骤说明」。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from cooking steps to life methods and the old medical prescription.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从烹饪步骤走向处世诀窍与旧时药方。

core.cn: 核心意象：灶边支着的一页编号步骤。

A method for a wanted result.

Kitchen order scales up to life order.
branches.cn: 厨房的秩序放大为生活的秩序。

branches.en: One page once fed both cook and patient.
branches.cn: 同一页纸曾同时服务厨房与病床。

definition_en: to say no to an offer, request, or thing
core_image: 合上的手掌挡回递来的东西
scene: 校门口有人递来传单，她摆了摆手。She refused the flyer with a polite shake of her head.
sceneCN: 这里 refuse 是「拒绝」（第 1 个义项：对提议说「不」）；句意为她礼貌地摇头，拒绝接传单。

derivatives.zh: 由 refuse 加 -al 构成，义为「拒绝」
由 refuse 加 -er 构成，义为「拒绝者」
同根否定词，义为「无可辩驳的」

senses.title: To say no to an offer
senses.definition: to decline an offer or invitation
senses.example: She refused the flyer with a polite shake of her head.
senses.exampleCN: 她礼貌地摇头，拒绝接传单。
senses.why: The core image is a closed palm turning things back, so the no sense leads.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是合起的手掌把东西挡回，最基本的义项就是说「不」。

senses.title: To be unwilling to act
senses.definition: to be unwilling to do something
senses.example: The old dog refused to leave the doorstep.
senses.exampleCN: 老狗不肯离开门口的台阶。
senses.why: The no turns inward against one's own action.
senses.whyCN: 「不」转向自身，拒绝自己的行动。

senses.title: To reject a request
senses.definition: to turn down a request or application
senses.example: The office refused his request for a later deadline.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室回绝了他延期截止的请求。
senses.why: A person's no becomes an institution's no.
senses.whyCN: 个人的「不」变成机构的「不」。

senses.title: Waste material as a noun
senses.definition: things thrown away, as rubbish
senses.example: Refuse was collected early this morning.
senses.exampleCN: 垃圾今晨一早就被收走了。
senses.why: What is pushed away ends as what is thrown away.
senses.whyCN: 被推拒之物最终成为被丢弃之物。

intro.en: Refuse pours back what is offered: the Latin root means to flow back.
intro.cn: refuse 把递来的东西「泼回去」：拉丁词根本义是「回流」。

items.en: Latin re- meant back and fundere meant to pour.
items.cn: 拉丁语 re- 意为回，fundere 意为倾倒。

items.en: refundere meant to pour back or reject.
items.cn: refundere 意为倒回、拒收。

items.en: Old French refuser carried the rejecting sense.
items.cn: 古法语 refuser 承载拒收义。

items.en: Middle English refusen named the saying of no.
items.cn: 中古英语 refusen 指说不。

items.en: Modern English refuse split into the verb and the rubbish noun.
items.cn: 现代英语 refuse 分为动词与垃圾名词。

note.en: The pour-back family shares the fund root; the near words differ in strength of no.
note.cn: 「倒回」词族共享 fund 词根；近义词的差异在拒绝的强度。

entries.definitionCN: 拒绝（名词），由 refuse 加 -al 构成

entries.definition: to refuse firmly, often about things

entries.definitionCN: 否认；拒绝给予，侧重言语

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the pour-back root and the no scene.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于「倒回」词根与说「不」的场景。

normal.en: refuse = re + fuse: what pours back to the giver.
normal.cn: refuse = re + fuse：倒回给给的人。

normal.en: Refuse the flyer, refuse to go: no thing, no act.
normal.cn: 拒绝传单、拒绝前往：不接物，不做事。

normal.en: refusal adds -al to name the act.
normal.cn: refusal 加 -al 指拒绝行为本身。

normal.en: The rubbish sense is what the city pushes back out.
normal.cn: 垃圾义是被城市「倒出去」的东西。

normal.en: Decline is the polite cousin of refuse.
normal.cn: decline 是 refuse 的礼貌亲戚。

abstract.en: A palm closing like a gate.
abstract.cn: 手掌像门一样合拢。

abstract.en: A package sliding back down a counter.
abstract.cn: 包裹沿柜台滑了回去。

abstract.en: A bin holding all the pushed-away things.
abstract.cn: 垃圾桶收容一切被推拒之物。

examples.en: She refused the flyer with a polite shake of her head.
examples.cn: 她礼貌地摇头，拒绝接传单。

examples.en: He refused to eat until everyone sat down.
examples.cn: 他坚持等所有人坐下才肯吃。

examples.en: The bank refused her loan application last week.
examples.cn: 银行上周拒绝了她的贷款申请。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 瑞弗斯 」——谐音「回头喷」，东西「噗」地喷回去，就是拒绝。

root: refuse 源自拉丁语 refundere（re- 回 + fundere 倾倒），意为「倒回、拒收」，经古法语 refuser 进入英语；同根词有 refusal、confuse（同倒），名词义「垃圾」由「被倒回之物」引申。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from turning back offers to unwilling acts, official rejection, and thrown-out waste.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从挡回提议走向不愿行动、机构回绝与被弃的垃圾。

definition_zh: 按铃；（铃）响；打电话；戒指；圆圈
definition_en: to make a bell sound, or a circle-shaped band worn on a finger
core_image: 课桌上震颤出声的铜铃
scene: 午休结束的走廊里，值日生抬手握铃。The student will ring the bell and open the classroom doors.
sceneCN: 这里 ring 是「按铃」（第 1 个义项：使铃发声）；句意为值日生摇铃后，教室的门都打开了。

derivatives.zh: 由 ring 加 -er 构成，义为「按铃者；声音相同的替身」
由 ring 加 tone 构成，义为「手机铃声」
复合词，义为「环城路」

senses.title: To make a bell sound
senses.definition: to cause a bell to make sound
senses.example: The student rang the bell and the classroom doors opened.
senses.exampleCN: 值日生摇铃后，教室的门都打开了。
senses.why: The core image is a trembling bell on a desk, so the sound sense leads.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是桌上的铃震颤出声，最基本的义项就是使铃发声。

senses.title: To sound as a bell
senses.definition: to give out a bell-like sound
senses.example: The phone rang twice and then went quiet.
senses.exampleCN: 电话响了两声就安静下来。
senses.why: What is struck becomes the striking sound itself.
senses.whyCN: 被敲之物自身成为敲出的声音。

senses.title: To call by phone
senses.definition: to make a telephone call, British use
senses.example: I will ring you when the train arrives.
senses.exampleCN: 火车到站我就给你打电话。
senses.why: The bell of the phone borrows the bell verb.
senses.whyCN: 电话铃借用敲铃的动词。

senses.title: A band worn on a finger
senses.definition: a small circle of metal worn on a finger
senses.definitionCN: 戴在手指上的小金属圈
senses.example: She wears a plain gold ring on her left hand.
senses.exampleCN: 她左手戴着一枚素金戒指。
senses.why: A circle of metal gets its own noun.
senses.whyCN: 金属圆圈独立成名词。

senses.title: A circle of things
senses.definition: a circle formed by people or things
senses.example: The children sat in a ring around the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们围火坐成一圈。
senses.why: The round shape ties bell and band together.
senses.whyCN: 圆的形状把铃声与圆环系在一起。

intro.en: Two old words share the letters: one about circles, one about sound.
intro.cn: 两个古词共享同一拼写：一个关于圆，一个关于声。

items.en: Old English hring named a circle or band.
items.cn: 古英语 hring 指圆环。

items.en: The Germanic root hring- meant something curved back on itself.
items.cn: 日耳曼语根 hring- 意为弯回自身之物。

items.en: Old English hringan meant to give a bell-like sound.
items.cn: 古英语 hringan 意为发出铃声。

items.en: Middle English used ring for bells, bands, and circles.
items.cn: 中古英语 ring 兼指铃、环与圆圈。

items.en: Modern English ring added the telephone use in Britain.
items.cn: 现代英语 ring 在英国又添打电话用法。

note.en: The circle family shares the ring shape; the near words differ in size and use.
note.cn: 圆环词族共享「圈」形；近义词的差异在尺寸与用途。

normal.en: Wedding rings are a circle with no end.
normal.cn: 婚戒是一个没有尽头的圆。

normal.en: ring–rang–rung for bells; ringed for circles.

normal.en: Ring someone up is British for call.

normal.en: A ring of trees is a circle standing around.

abstract.en: Children's heads forming a ring round a fire.

examples.en: She wears a plain gold ring on her left hand.

definition_en: a line of things, or the act of moving a boat with oars
core_image: 湖面上一排木桨划开水波
scene: 清晨的湖面浮着薄雾，木桨碰着船舷作响。The students row across the lake before their first class.
sceneCN: 这里 row 是「划船」（第 1 个义项：用桨推动船）；句意为学生们在第一节课前划船穿过湖面。

derivatives.zh: 由 row 加 -er 构成，义为「划船者」
由 row 加 -ing 构成，义为「划船运动」
相关词，义为「桨」

senses.title: To move a boat with oars
senses.definition: to push a boat forward with oars
senses.example: The students row across the lake before their first class.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们在第一节课前划船穿过湖面。
senses.why: The core image is oars dipping in a line, so the rowing sense leads.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是木桨成排入水，最基本的义项就是划船。

senses.title: A line of people or things
senses.definition: a neat line of people or objects
senses.definitionCN: 人或物排成的整齐直线
senses.example: Beans grew in neat rows behind the school.
senses.exampleCN: 学校后面的菜畦里豆子成行生长。
senses.why: Things placed like oars side by side form a row.
senses.whyCN: 并列如桨之物排成一行。

senses.title: A trip by rowing
senses.definition: a journey or outing made by rowing
senses.definitionCN: 以划船方式完成的出行
senses.example: They took a morning row up the river.
senses.exampleCN: 他们清晨沿河划了一段船。
senses.why: The act becomes the outing itself.
senses.whyCN: 行为本身成为这次出行。

senses.title: To carry people in a rowing boat
senses.definition: to move passengers in a boat with oars
senses.example: The ferryman rows visitors to the island each hour.
senses.exampleCN: 船夫每小时划船把游客送到岛上。
senses.why: Rowing aims at passengers now, not only motion.
senses.whyCN: 划桨的目标由行进转为载客。

intro.en: Row comes straight from the old word for pulling oars in order.
intro.cn: row 直接来自古语中「按序拉桨」的词。

items.en: Old English rowan meant to move a boat with oars.
items.cn: 古英语 rowan 意为以桨行船。

items.en: Old Norse roa shared the same oar-pulling root.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 roa 共享拉桨词根。

items.en: The Germanic root also gave Latin terms for oars by contact.
items.cn: 该日耳曼词根经接触影响了表桨的词汇。

items.en: Middle English rowen carried the boat sense daily.
items.cn: 中古英语 rowen 日常用作行船义。

items.en: The line sense grew from things set side by side like oars.
items.cn: 排、行义由并排如桨之物引申而来。

note.en: The oar family shares the pulling root; the near words differ by motion and place.

intro.en: Travel begins in a word for toil: old journeys meant suffering on the road.
intro.cn: travel 起于「劳苦」之词：古时的旅途意味着路上的艰辛。

items.en: Old French travailler meant to work hard, even to torture.
items.cn: 古法语 travailler 意为辛苦劳作，甚至折磨。

items.en: Late Latin tripaliare came from an instrument of torment.
items.cn: 后期拉丁语 tripaliare 来自刑具之名。

items.en: Middle English travailen meant to toil and to journey.
items.cn: 中古英语 travailen 兼指劳苦与远行。

items.en: The spelling split travail and travel by use.
items.cn: 拼写依用法分家为 travail 与 travel。

items.en: Modern English travel kept the journey and softened the pain.
items.cn: 现代英语 travel 保留旅程义，磨去了苦楚。

note.en: The toil family shares the suffering root; the near words differ in distance and aim.
note.cn: 劳苦词族共享「受难」词根；近义词的差异在距离与目的。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the toil root and the platform scene.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想基于劳苦词根与站台场景。

normal.en: Travel once meant toil: old roads were hard.
normal.cn: travel 旧指劳苦：古路难行。

normal.en: Travail, with two ls, still means painful labor.
normal.cn: 双 l 的 travail 至今指痛苦的劳作。

normal.en: Travel light means carry little.
normal.cn: travel light 指轻装上阵。

normal.en: News travels fast: journeys spread stories.
normal.cn: news travels fast：行程传播消息。

normal.en: A traveler carries the -er of the doer.
normal.cn: traveler 带动作者的 -er 词尾。

abstract.en: Suitcase wheels humming on platform stone.
abstract.cn: 行李箱轮子在站台石面上低鸣。

abstract.en: A rumor hopping from door to door.
abstract.cn: 流言在门与门之间跳跃。

abstract.en: A train window sliding villages backward.
abstract.cn: 车窗外村庄缓缓后移。

examples.en: They travel to the coast by train every summer.
examples.cn: 他们每年夏天乘火车去海边旅行。

examples.en: News of the festival traveled fast through town.
examples.cn: 节日的消息很快传遍了小镇。

examples.en: The family plans to travel during the spring holidays.
examples.cn: 一家人计划春假期间去旅行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 踩我 」——行李箱轮子「踩」着地面「滚滚」向前，travel 就是上路远行。

root: travel 源自古法语 travailler（劳苦，源自后期拉丁语 tripaliare，与刑具 tripalium 相关），中古英语 travailen 兼指劳苦与远行，后拼写分化：travel 专指旅行，travail 保留「苦役」义。
